Get involved

It starts here.

Six ways in, from a Tuesday night at Happy Dog to sponsoring a season. All of them welcome first-timers.

01 · Come to an event

Show up once. That's the whole trick.

Everything is free and on Meetup: big nights, monthly socials, workshops, hikes. Say hello to whoever is nearest.

Join on Meetup

02 · Get the newsletter

One email a month. Dates, recaps, jobs.

03 · Speak

Tell the room what you built.

A real project, what broke, what you'd do differently. Twenty to forty minutes, questions after. First-time speakers welcome; we'll help you shape it.

Or pitch by email

04 · Volunteer

An evening a month keeps it running.

Door, name tags, photos, a hand with the room. No long-term commitment; tell us what you're good at and when you're free.

Email to volunteer

05 · Sponsor

Keep it free for everyone.

Sixteen organizations covered 2026. Companies can also give in kind, match their employees' gifts, run a workshop, or share job openings.

Sponsor or partner with us

06 · Donate

Twenty dollars covers a night's Meetup fees.

Donations pay the platform and venue costs that sponsors don't. Every dollar goes to events; nobody here is paid. CLE AI & DATA is a 501(c)(3) nonprofit, so donations are tax-deductible as allowed by law.

Does your employer match gifts? Many do for a 501(c)(3). Ask HR and your donation can count twice. They'll want our legal name, Cleveland AI and Data, and our EIN, 42-2843242.
